blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—The last playdate of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup elimination round on Friday will finally determine the remaining questions surrounding the composition of the best-of-five crossover quarterfinals. Rain or Shine and Phoenix play in the first game at 5:15 p.m. at Ynares Center in this city, before Barangay Ginebra battles Blackwater at 7:30 p.m. to conclude the group stage, which was stalled by a long break due to Gilas Pilipinas commitments.
